parsed.production_notes: The main visual is a human hand interacting with printed paper, but the voiceover sounds like a synthetic AI voice. The final scene is a 3D rendered smartphone animation.

characters.appearance: Human right hand, medium complexion. Wears a simple silver band on the index finger.

panels.panel_visual_description: Top-down view of a wooden desk surface. A right hand holding a thick black and orange marker interacts with a white sheet of paper. The hand draws orange lines, circles, and arrows on the paper. The paper is swapped out for new sheets multiple times.

scenes.visual_description: A top-down shot of a hand using a marker to highlight and draw on printed papers resting on a wooden desk. The papers contain various illustrations and text related to time management and language learning. The hand flips through several pages, emphasizing different points with the marker. Text overlays translate the spoken Telugu.
